action.consoleSubtitle: By default only the single most recommended step is kept. Other actions remain, but move into the collapsed area below to avoid crowding the right-side buttons.
action.primary.genPlan.label: Generate execution plan first
action.primary.genPlan.reason: This chapter still lacks a clear goal and task sheet; filling in the execution plan first makes writing flow better.
action.primary.genPlanRunning.label: Generating execution plan...
action.primary.needsRepair.reason: This chapter already has content. Even if the review finds issues, that should not block further editing; you can enter the editor first, or use one-click repair below.
action.primary.openEditor.label: Open chapter editor
action.primary.openEditorFinal.reason: This chapter already has content; entering the editor directly is more efficient for fine edits and recovery.
action.primary.runAudit.label: Run full review
action.primary.runAudit.reason: The content is out; run a full review first, then decide whether to repair or keep rewriting.
action.primary.runAuditRunning.label: Running full review...
action.primary.selectChapter.label: Select a chapter first
action.primary.selectChapter.reason: Select the chapter you want to advance from the left first, so the system knows what to do next for you.
action.primary.write.label: Write this chapter
action.primary.write.reason: The preparation is sufficient; the most worthwhile step now is to generate this chapter's content directly.
action.primary.writeRunning.label: Writing this chapter...
action.recommendHint: If you are unsure what to click, prefer the recommended action here. More detailed capabilities are all below.
action.strategyHint: When unsure, keep the defaults. Only adjust manually when you clearly know this chapter needs a faster pace, stronger conflict, or higher freedom.
basicInfo.directorTakeover.description: If the basics are fairly complete, you can start automatic takeover directly from a chosen step, and choose to continue existing progress or rerun the current step.
basicInfo.directorTakeover.title: Let AI take over from the current project
basicInfo.section.description: Keep refining the title, synopsis, readers, and selling points so later auto-direction and chapter generation can stably inherit the current direction.
basicInfo.section.title: Book-level positioning and basic info
basicInfo.writingTips.description: Confirm this book's narrative flavor, expressive density, and style references to keep later chapters consistent.
basicInfo.writingTips.title: Writing tips
cast.applyDefault: Synced {{created}} new characters and updated {{updated}} existing characters.
cast.applyHint: After applying a cast, characters are created/updated in sync and the character asset workspace is refreshed.
cast.applyOverride: Applied this cast per your confirmation, synced {{created}} new characters and updated {{updated}} existing characters.
cast.backgroundHint: Visible profiles and character dynamics are completed in the background; refresh the character assets later to view them.
cast.clearedRecords: Cleared {{count}} cast option records; synced characters and relations will not roll back automatically.
cast.confirm.apply: Apply it to the character asset workspace anyway? After applying you can keep adjusting in the character assets.
cast.confirm.mismatch: The cast "{{title}}" still has parts that do not fully match the current story settings.
cast.confirmClearApplied: Clear all current cast option records? Synced characters and relations will not roll back automatically.
cast.confirmDeleteApplied: Delete the option "{{title}}"? This only deletes the option record and does not roll back synced characters and relations.
cast.deletedRecord: The option record was deleted; the corresponding data in the character library and relationship network is kept.
cast.genInstructionHint: You can add the protagonist's desire, antagonist pressure, relationship tension, or the character directions you want to emphasize.
cast.genInstructionPlaceholder: e.g., The protagonist must choose between family duty and personal freedom; the villain should not be purely evil but driven by protectiveness and control.
cast.loadingWorldScope: Reading this book's world usage scope...
cast.needsConfirmBody: The system found parts that do not fully match the current story settings. You can apply first, then adjust in the character assets.
cast.needsConfirmTitle: This cast needs your confirmation before applying
cast.noFocusHint: When no character is selected, the most recent relationship entries are shown by default.
cast.noOptions: No cast options yet. Enter some character direction first, then click "Generate 3 casts".
cast.noRelations: No character relations yet. They will appear here after applying a cast.
cast.subtitle: Better suited for early character-system building, or replanning the cast after a major change in story direction.
cast.title: AI cast options
cast.useWorld: Generate based on this book's world
cast.worldAlignHint: Characters will primarily align with this book's world factions, locations, identity boundaries, and forbidden pairings.
cast.worldNotReady: This book's world is not ready yet. This round designs characters primarily from book-level info and your generation instruction.
cast.worldScopeHint: After organizing this book's world usage scope, you can further specify a faction preference.
cast.worldSliceNotReady: This book's world exists, but its usage scope is not organized yet. Consider organizing the usage scope on the basic-info page first, or let AI generate conservatively per the world manual.
chapterStatusDesc.completed: Completed: this chapter passed the current flow; you can keep polishing or move to the next chapter.
chapterStatusDesc.generating: Writing: AI is generating this chapter's content, or doing post-generation finalizing.
chapterStatusDesc.needsRepair: Repair suggested: the review found issues, but it does not block further editing. You can one-click repair, or keep writing first.
chapterStatusDesc.pendingGeneration: To write: the chapter plan is mostly ready; you can start generating the content.
chapterStatusDesc.pendingReview: Reviewed: the content finished the current review round. You can view suggestions, keep editing directly, or address issues as needed.
chapterStatusDesc.unplanned: To prep: this chapter still lacks execution material; usually add the chapter goal, task sheet, or scene cards first.
chapterStatusDesc.unset: Not set: this chapter has no clear flow status yet.
diagnostics.description: This is better expanded when you need to fill gaps, find missing pieces, or map relationships. For daily editing, use the character asset workspace below first.
diagnostics.title: Cast and relationship diagnostics
dynamics.manualTitle: Manually adjust this character's dynamic state
dynamics.noCandidates: No new character candidates to confirm yet. After writing a few chapters, this automatically gathers entries for new characters extracted by AI.
dynamics.noDuties: This volume has no character-duty projection yet. Click "Rebuild dynamic characters" above to initialize it.
dynamics.noRelations: No relationship-stage data yet. It appears here automatically after applying a cast or completing chapters.
dynamics.subtitle: This brings volume duties, absence risk, new character candidates, and relationship stages back into the character page's main flow, so you no longer track them manually.
dynamics.summaryPlaceholder: Add the reason for this change, its follow-up effect, or key points to remind the planner.
dynamics.title: Dynamic character system
flow.note.executionPlanDone: This chapter's execution plan is complete.
flow.note.executionPlanTodo: This chapter still lacks an execution plan; the system will prepare a task sheet or scene breakdown first.
flow.note.payoffSyncInProgress: The system is calibrating the foreshadow ledger involved in this chapter.
flow.note.payoffSyncTodo: After assets are backfilled, the system calibrates the foreshadow ledger by risk and pace.
flow.note.readyDone: This chapter has reached a state ready to continue.
flow.note.readyInProgress: This chapter finished the current review round. You can keep editing or handle the suggestions first.
flow.note.readyTodo: After finishing the earlier steps, this chapter can continue.
flow.note.repairInProgress: The system is repairing the content based on the issues.
flow.note.repairTodo: If the review finds issues, this enters the repair stage.
flow.note.reviewInProgress: The content is generated; the system is reviewing it.
flow.note.reviewTodo: The content has material; the next step is review.
flow.note.stateSyncInProgress: The content is readable; the system is backfilling this chapter's state, character changes, and key resources.
flow.note.stateSyncTodo: Once the content is readable, the system backfills this chapter's state and key resources.
flow.note.writingInProgress: AI is writing this chapter's content.
flow.note.writingTodo: The execution plan is ready; you can start writing the content.
generationStateDesc.approved: Approved: this chapter passed the current quality gate; auto-execution treats it as done and skips it.
generationStateDesc.drafted: Drafted: a content draft was generated, but review confirmation is not complete.
generationStateDesc.planned: In outline: the chapter is in the outline or split result, but has no content draft yet.
generationStateDesc.published: Published: this chapter is in a published state; auto-execution will not regenerate it.
generationStateDesc.repaired: Repaired: one repair round based on the issues is done; usually the next step is another review or confirmation.
generationStateDesc.reviewed: Reviewed: one review round is complete; repair or confirmation may follow.
management.cardDescription: Make this a true main workbench: the left only switches chapters, the middle fully holds the content, and the right focuses on AI actions and strategy.
management.noCharacters: Please add at least 1 character before generating chapter content. This makes it easier for AI to identify who appears, relationship changes, and plot continuity.
management.takeover.description: AI first checks whether there is an active batch, checkpoint, or executable chapter range, then decides whether to resume the current batch or start a new one per your choice.
management.takeover.title: Take over from chapter execution
payoff.canonicalHint: Later planning, writing, review, and repair should consume the canonical results here first, rather than fixating on a single raw field.
payoff.card.description: This is a book-level canonical foreshadow ledger that does not switch with the current volume. It is collapsed by default; expand it when you need to inspect an entire foreshadow chain or overall payoff pressure.
payoff.card.title: Book-wide canonical foreshadow ledger
payoff.emptyLedger: There is no usable canonical foreshadow ledger yet. On first entry to an older project the system lazily syncs this ledger; if it is still empty, the related planning or state material is not yet sufficient.
payoff.emptySnapshot: No usable foreshadow state snapshot yet. After running chapter generation or audits, the states here will gradually fill in.
payoff.pendingEmpty: No foreshadow states to follow up right now.
payoff.snapshotHint: This shows the book-wide latest state, not limited to the current volume, to help judge overall payoff pressure.
queue.empty: No chapters under the current filter yet.
queue.subtitle: The left side only handles switching chapters and viewing progress, leaving the full reading area to the main writing panel in the middle.
queue.title: Chapter queue
queuePreview.noObjective: This chapter has no clear goal yet; adding a chapter plan first is a good idea.
queuePreview.oldSceneCards: This chapter has an old scene breakdown; consider regenerating it.
queuePreview.sceneBudgetGenerated: This chapter has a generated scene-budget contract.
result.emptyContent: This chapter has no content yet. Consider adding a chapter plan or task sheet first, then run "Write this chapter" directly from the right.
result.emptySelect: Select a chapter from the left first; this becomes the main writing area for the current chapter, showing content, task sheet, quality feedback, and repair records together.
result.finalizingDetail: The content is readable; the system is saving the draft and backfilling chapter assets.
result.liveWritingDetail: AI is continuously producing this chapter's content; watch the pace and feel here, and stop anytime if you are not satisfied.
result.noObjective: This chapter has no clear goal yet; consider adding a chapter plan first.
result.writingInOther.description: {{label}} is still generating. After switching to this chapter, its streaming content is no longer carried over; return to that chapter to keep viewing its live output.
result.writingInOther.title: Another chapter is still being written in the background
runtime.audit.title: Current issues and repair suggestions
runtime.context.fromReplan: This chapter comes from a replanning adjustment.
runtime.context.referencedIssues: This chapter references {{count}} pending audit issues.
runtime.context.title: Chapter goal and context
runtime.length.empty: There is no length-control replay yet. After generating this chapter, the budget execution results will appear here.
runtime.length.noExtraRepair: No extra length adjustment was triggered this time.
runtime.length.noOverlength: No over-length adjustment was triggered this time.
runtime.length.overlengthApplied: Over-length adjustment was triggered this time.
runtime.length.title: Length control and execution replay
sidebar.confirmDelete: Delete character "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
sidebar.noCharacters: This novel has no characters yet; create or import characters in the wizard above first.
sidebar.noProtagonist: No protagonist is marked in the current cast; you can add protagonist info in character positioning.
sidebar.onlyProtagonist: The current cast has only a protagonist; you can add antagonists, allies, or relationship-pressure characters later.
workspace.currentGoalPlaceholder: Current goal (e.g., break through within three months)
workspace.currentStatePlaceholder: Current state (e.g., in seclusion recovering from severe injury)
workspace.diffPreviewHint: After clicking "AI-complete visible profile", the differences to be saved appear here first; confirm before saving to the character card.
workspace.emptySelect: Select a character from the left first, then enter detailed asset editing.
workspace.generatingFor: Organizing appearance, physique, voice, and entrance memory points for "{{name}}".
workspace.guidanceHint: When left blank, it auto-completes per the novel's settings; when filled, AI generates writable suggestions per your preference first.
workspace.guidancePlaceholder: Completion preference (optional): e.g., more intimidating, slightly frail, gentler voice, not a traditional beauty
workspace.noEvents: No events yet; click "Sync character timeline" first.
workspace.profileField.appearance.label: Appearance memory points
workspace.profileField.appearance.placeh: Eyes, hairstyle, habitual expressions, and other memorable appearance traits
workspace.profileField.attireStyle.label: Common attire
workspace.profileField.attireStyle.place: Everyday attire, identity appearance, class or occupational traces
workspace.profileField.physique.label: Physique baseline
workspace.profileField.physique.placehol: Age impression, body shape, movement posture, and baseline physical state
workspace.profileField.presenceImpressio: The direct impression readers get on first or routine entrances
workspace.profileField.signatureDetail.p: Signature objects, gestures, micro-habits, scent, or reusable details
workspace.profileField.voiceTexture.plac: Voice, speaking rhythm, sentence habits, and tone
workspace.resourceMode.longterm.helper: Long-term characters prioritize resources that change action choices, relationship leverage, reader awareness, or foreshadow payoffs.
workspace.resourceMode.longterm.label: Long-term character key resources
workspace.resourceMode.protagonist.helpe: The protagonist shows full items, clues, identity credentials, hidden cards, and consumption states; later chapters prioritize these action boundaries.
workspace.resourceMode.protagonist.label: Full protagonist resources
workspace.resourceMode.temporary.helper: Temporary characters only show resources that are reused across chapters, drive conflict, bind foreshadowing, or are taken by the protagonist.
workspace.resourceMode.temporary.label: Temporary character resources
workspace.resourcesEmpty: Key items, clues, identity credentials, or hidden cards settle here after chapter writing; temporary characters keep only resources that affect later chapters.
workspace.reviewDiffHint: Review the differences below first, then click Save to character card to confirm.
workspace.subtitle: The left switches characters; the right handles the current character's state, motivation, growth arc, and timeline together.
workspace.suggestionNone: "{{name}}" currently has no writable visible profile
workspace.title: Character asset workspace
workspace.visibleProfileHint: Complete the character's appearance, physique, voice, and entrance memory points; later chapters prioritize highly recognizable information.
